Agra Father Accused of Killing Daughter Over Court Marriage

In Agra, a 22-year-old woman named Ankita Sharma was allegedly killed by her father after she married an ITBP soldier through a court marriage. Reports indicate the father was angered by her marriage. Some reports mention the daughter was pregnant and the father is accused of drowning her in the Chambal river. Police have arrested the father and are awaiting a post-mortem report. The search for the body in the river is ongoing.
